The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it as an Orthodox icon of Philip the Apostle from the Dormition Church at Kondopoga. The description says Apostle, which is this folder's type, and so is not Philip the Deacon of the Seventy or Philip Metropolitan of Moscow. Commons describes it: Philip the Apostle. Orthodox icon from the Dormition Church, Kondopoga, Republic of Karelia, northern Russia. The Dormition Church of Kondopoga (Успенская церковь) was built in 1774 and is a rare monument of Russian wooden architecture. The Church is dedicated to the Dormition of Virgin Mary, Mother of God.
